defect: the stream payload register is granted extra cycles without a holding enable
rationale: payload_q updates on every clk_i edge from the stream input; no protocol condition holds it for three cycles. The multicycle exception therefore relaxes a live single-cycle register path without justification.

mutation.description: Added a three-cycle exception to the payload register path without an enable that delays its update.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Retained the clocked stream payload and valid delay shape; reduced the handshake state machine and counter to a fixed one-stage register.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: payload_q captures new data every cycle with no enable, so a 3-cycle setup multicycle on payload_q->payload_o is unearned.
